attributes.action: Keep the 10-Year Long Residence ILR Rules Unchanged for Existing Residents
attributes.additional_details: We ask the UK Government to protect people already living in the UK under the 10-year long residence route. Many have spent years lawfully residing, working, paying taxes, National Insurance and IHS, and contributing to society, including during the COVID-19 pandemic. It would be unfair to change the rules after years of commitment and sacrifice. Please introduce transitional protection and allow existing residents to achieve ILR under the rules they have relied upon.
attributes.background: Protect the existing 10-year long residence ILR rules for people already in the UK. Recognise their years of lawful residence, hard work, tax and NI contributions, IHS payments and sacrifices. Do not change the goalposts for those who have built their lives here.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Keep 10-year Long Residence Route for people already living in the UK
